title: Aphelion + Auth — preferred-admin exports and notification bridge
content:
Tonight's Aphelion/Auth pass clarified where public selection ends and owner-level curation begins. The selected-image JSON manifest for regular users was removed; Aphelion now keeps public selection as a local viewing interaction, while export power moves to the preferred-admin Options page.

What changed:

  • Public/user boundary: visitors can still view Aphelion and Highlights and click/select images locally, but they do not see Selected, Clear, the selected page, or download/export controls.
  • Preferred-admin controls: the Options page now has owner-only JSON exports for the full image catalog and the active highlighted-image set.
  • Highlights maintenance: the soft reset controls remain preferred-admin-only, with preview counts and confirmation before changing the public Highlights summary.
  • Auth notification bridge: Aphelion export/reset actions now log into Auth history/notifications through the shared internal log channel, giving us one place to decide which cross-app events deserve attention.

The important design decision is that Aphelion's public surface can stay playful and visible, while master viewership, exports, resets, and future audit-worthy actions live behind Auth's preferred-admin model. This should make tomorrow's testing much cleaner: public visitor, regular user, regular admin, and preferred admin each have a distinct role to verify.
